description: Supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning approaches applied to trade signal generation, execution, and strategy discovery.

techniques.name: Conditional Autoencoders for Factor Discovery
techniques.description: Autoencoders that incorporate firm characteristics as conditioning variables to discover non-linear latent asset pricing factors. Proposed by Gu, Kelly, and Xiu (2021) in the Journal of Econometrics.
techniques.verification_notes: Confirmed published in Journal of Econometrics 2021. R-squared improvements of 5-15% over linear models reported in literature.

techniques.name: XGBoost / LightGBM Cross-Sectional Return Prediction
techniques.description: Gradient boosted tree models for cross-sectional stock return prediction, typically achieving Sharpe ratios of 1.5-2.5 in academic studies. Popular due to handling of missing data, built-in feature importance, and fast training.
techniques.verification_notes: Gu, Kelly, Xiu (2020) 'Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning' confirmed as seminal reference. Qlib framework verified on GitHub.

techniques.name: Graph Neural Networks for Stock Relationships
techniques.description: GNNs that model inter-stock relationships through supply chain linkages, sector co-membership, and correlation networks. The Relational Stock Ranking (RSR) framework is a notable example.
techniques.verification_notes: Multiple papers confirm GNN effectiveness for capturing stock relational structures.

techniques.name: Temporal Fusion Transformers (TFT)
techniques.description: Attention-based architecture combining recurrent layers for local processing with self-attention for long-term dependencies. Handles static covariates, known future inputs, and observed time series. Published by Lim, Arik, Loeff, Pfister (2021).
techniques.verification_notes: Confirmed published in International Journal of Forecasting 2021. Widely cited in financial forecasting literature.

techniques.name: N-BEATS (Neural Basis Expansion Analysis)
techniques.description: Deep architecture using backward and forward residual links for interpretable time series forecasting. Decomposes forecasts into trend and seasonality components. By Oreshkin, Carpov, Chapados, Bengio (2020).
techniques.verification_notes: Confirmed ICLR 2020 paper. 11% improvement over statistical benchmarks on M4 competition.

techniques.name: State Space Models (Mamba) for Financial Sequences
techniques.description: Selective state space models that efficiently process long sequences with linear complexity. Being adapted for financial time series from NLP origins.
techniques.verification_notes: Mamba architecture confirmed. Financial applications are emerging but less established than transformer approaches.
